_readme: Links and settings for the Resources tab. Reports: only reports published in the current year, each linked to the report itself, with the publication date checked by hand (last checked 2026-09-26). Older editions are removed when a new year starts; the monthly check flags new editions. Descriptions are our own words. group: market | travel. access is shown only when a report isn't free. Learning material (research papers such as Cornell's) belongs in articles and case studies, not here.

roomSlabs.note: No input tax credit (ITC) for the hotel. Applies to every room up to ₹7,500 a night; the old exemption for rooms under ₹1,000 was withdrawn in July 2022.

food.note: Food and drinks served in a hotel are taxed at 18% if any room in that hotel was sold above ₹7,500 a night in the previous financial year (a "specified premises"), otherwise 5%.

sources.name: GST Council: recommendations of the 56th meeting (official press release, Sep 2025, PDF)
Business Standard: 18% GST on restaurants in hotels above ₹7,500
Angel One: 18% GST for restaurant services in hotels with tariffs above ₹7,500
